title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij: lichen_coap_oscore_respond fallback loses intended error code for deaddrop
description:
The shared function `lichen_coap_oscore_respond` (added in b012f03) always falls back to COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_INTERNAL_ERROR (5.00) when OSCORE protection fails.

Before this commit, the deaddrop handler's `deaddrop_oscore_respond` passed through the intended response code (e.g. TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, BAD_REQUEST) on protect failure. The new shared function discards the intended code and sends 5.00 instead.

Affected file: lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/coap_oscore.c:227-238

Old behavior (deaddrop): send intended error code unencrypted
New behavior: always send 5.00

Fix: add the intended code param to the fallback path in lichen_coap_oscore_respond, or restore per-resource fallback behavior.
